يقترضوا (form VIII)
# يَقْتَرِضُوا (yaqtariḍū) /jaq.ta.ri.dˤuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَرَضَ (iqtaraḍa)
# يُقْتَرَضُوا (yuqtaraḍū) /juq.ta.ra.dˤuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَرَضَ (iqtaraḍa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
